title: The repeats label on the timing strip's ruler never sits on top of a tick number
goal: When the loop starts over exactly on a ruler tick (a lone 800 ms spinner, for one), the strip's "repeats" label is drawn over the tick's number and reads as "800eats". Each should be readable on its own, the way the spinner mock keeps its "and again" label clear of the ruler.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-15: `Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/a-lone-spinner-strip-reads-one-turn-walk.json` then look at /tmp/photonz-playtest/a-lone-spinner-strip-reads-one-turn/1-one-turn-sc.png: the ruler reads "|800" with "repeats" printed over it at the same x (garbled "800eats"). Same picture saved as queue/audits/2026-10-15-forever-turn-reading-2.png. The label is MotionStripMarksView in Sources/Photonz/MotionStripView.swift (~line 1102), offset to laneWidth * ruler.repeatsFraction at the top of the marks overlay, which is the ruler's row. The mock (icon-loop-wt.html #wrapMark) labels the restart "and again" and draws it down in the lanes. Whether to also take the mock's word is part of the fix.
acceptance: With a lone 800 ms Forever spinner, the ruler's 800 and the repeats label are both readable in a real capture, neither drawn over the other
A lap that ends between ticks still shows its repeats label where it does today
The fix is checked in a walk picture (a-lone-spinner-strip-reads-one-turn-walk shows the case)

log.note: Built and verified in 12fefd7a. Reproduced first: 1-one-turn-sc.png read 800 with repeats over it. Fix: MotionStripRuler.repeatsLabelPlace (PhotonzCore, 5 tests in MotionStripRepeatsLabelTests) says when the label would touch a tick's number; MotionStripMarksView then drops it by the ruler's height (just under the ruler, above the first heading). Between ticks it stays on the ruler (motion-timing-strip-walk 7-shorter: 900 ms reads repeats between 800 and 1000). Also made the restart mark dashed accent 70% with an accent label, matching icon-animate-wt, icon-phase-wt and icon-loop-wt. I opened every audit picture and both show the intended look. Walks green: a-lone-spinner-strip-reads-one-turn, motion-timing-strip, a-ring-or-arc-arrives-spinning, forever-spinner-keeps-its-own-pace. Scripts/test.sh green, 13279 tests. MotionStripView.swift is shared, not forked, so Current gets the same fix. Open: the spinner mock words it "and again" under the last lane; decision card filed, recommending the built version. If the answer is a, this task only needs closing.

Fix shipped in 12fefd7a (label never sits on a ruler number, walk picture in the audit). Waiting on the card about the spinner mock's wording and placement ("and again" under the last lane vs "repeats" under the ruler).

decision "When a spinner's turn starts over right on a ruler number, where should the restart label go and what should it say?" resolved: "repeats", just under the 800 (Taken as recommended: the user, 2026-10-19, said there were too many cards, most did not matter and they could not follow them. Change it later only if they complain about the result)
